10 per post · 3 drawn from bound terms
No publishing, no scheduling, no analytics — no social OAuth or provider exists in this build. Records are real local workflow state only.

Render 05 — PROPOSED: Social station. Keeps the honest boundary the current SocialPulse room already enforces (no OAuth, no publisher, no analytics — reach and engagement read UNKNOWN) while adding the term-matched carousel panels and the handoff back into the master brain.
